battle.name: 俄格戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所載的俄格戰爭，於二零零八年八月在喬治亞境內爆發，俄羅斯與喬治亞在南奧塞梯亞及阿布哈茲地區交戰。俄軍使用蘇聯主戰坦克T-72，其正式型號自一九七三年起列裝，是地面部隊的重要坦克，並構成俄軍地面作戰體系的重要組成。

kit.name: 主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯陸軍的主力中型坦克，編入坦克部隊，負責正面突破、攻堅與伴隨步兵作戰，並提供直接的火力支援。

countries: 2008年8月7日夜間至8月12日，主要交戰者是喬治亞與俄羅斯聯邦。南奧塞梯亞武裝在戰役中站在俄方一側作戰，阿布哈茲分離當局的武裝則與進入當地的俄軍協同作戰。南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲均為未被聯合國承認為獨立國家的分離當局控制區，戰線由喬治亞、俄羅斯國家軍隊與當地武裝共同構成，不能簡化成兩個主權國家間的單純交鋒；軍事行動發生在喬治亞主張管轄、且在部分地區實際控制的領土上。主要戰線由南奧塞梯亞的羅基隧道、茨欣瓦利與戈里公路，延伸到北高加索和科多里峽谷，另以阿布哈茲的黑海沿岸公路連接蘇庫米方向。俄方介入的公開政治理由是保護南奧塞梯亞的俄羅斯維和人員及第777軍事基地，並阻止喬治亞攻勢；喬治亞則把行動定性為收回主權領土。
countriesEn: From the night of 7 August to 12 August 2008, the principal belligerents were Georgia and the Russian Federation. South Ossetian forces fought on the Russian side, while Abkhaz separatist forces cooperated with Russian troops entering the area. Neither South Ossetia nor Abkhazia had been recognized by the United Nations as an independent state, so the front combined the national armed forces of Georgia and Russia with local armed forces and cannot be reduced to a simple clash between two sovereign states; the fighting took place on territory claimed by Georgia and actually controlled by it in parts. The principal theaters ran from the Roki Tunnel, Tskhinvali and the Gori road through the North Caucasus and the Kodori Gorge, while the Black Sea coastal road in Abkhazia connected toward Sukhumi. Russia’s stated public political reason for intervention was to protect its peacekeeping personnel and the 777th Military Base in South Ossetia and to stop the Georgian offensive; Georgia defined its operation as the recovery of sovereign territory.
people: 戰役的政治授權與前線指揮分成兩條鏈。喬治亞總統米海爾·薩卡什維利在7日批准對南奧塞梯亞採取軍事行動；國防部長達維特·凱澤拉什維利負責行政與軍隊協調，總參謀長喬治·卡沙亞以及第2、第3、第4摩托化步兵旅的指揮官在前線執行命令。俄羅斯方面，總統德米特里·梅德韋杰夫代表介入的政治決定，總理弗拉基米爾·普丁說明莫斯科的安全立場，國防部長阿納托利·謝爾杜科夫負責軍事部署，第58集團軍司令阿納托利·比留科夫指揮前線部隊。南奧塞梯亞武裝指揮官謝爾蓋·巴加什科夫參與地面協同。8月12日促成停火的法國總統尼古拉·薩科齊不是作戰指揮者，卻是談判與安排停火的關鍵人物。區分這些角色，才能看清誰決定升級、誰調動部隊、誰在最後一刻同意停止射擊。
peopleEn: The campaign’s political authorization and battlefield command ran through two separate chains. Georgian President Mikheil Saakashvili approved Georgian military action against South Ossetia on 7 August; Defence Minister Davit Kezerashvili handled administration and coordination with the armed forces, while Chief of General Staff Giorgi Kashaia and the commanders of the 2nd, 3rd and 4th Motor Rifle Brigades carried out orders on the front. On the Russian side, President Dmitry Medvedev represented the political decision to intervene, Prime Minister Vladimir Putin articulated Moscow’s security position, Defence Minister Anatoly Serdyukov oversaw military deployment, and Anatoly Biryukov commanded the front-line forces of the 58th Combined Arms Army. Sergey Bagashkov, commander of the South Ossetian armed forces, participated in ground coordination. French President Nicolas Sarkozy, who helped bring about the ceasefire on 12 August, was not a battlefield commander but was a key figure in the negotiations and ceasefire arrangements. Keeping these roles separate shows who authorized escalation, who moved troops, and who agreed to stop firing at the last moment.
kits: 裝備並非每個型號都在每個戰區出現；以下是第58集團軍及相關航空力量的作戰序列中可確認的種類，這些型號在2008年以前均已列裝。俄方地面部隊使用T-72B與T-72B3主戰坦克、BMP-1與BMP-2步兵戰鬥車、空降和空突單位使用的BMD-1與BMD-2，以及BTR-80裝甲運兵車；砲兵包括2S19 Msta-S自走式152毫米榴彈砲、2S3 Akatsiya自走式122毫米榴彈砲、BM-21 Grad火箭砲和9K33 Oplot戰術火箭系統。航空與直升機包括Su-24M、Su-25T、MiG-29K，Mi-24P/V攻擊直升機，以及Mi-8MT、Mi-26運輸直升機。喬治亞方面的軍械序列可見T-72B、T-72B3、BMP-1/2、BTR-70、D-30、2S3 Akatsiya、BM-21 Grad，航空作戰使用Su-25、Su-22M3和MiG-29G/92，防空則有S-200與S-125。與這些系統配套的火力包括125毫米坦克砲彈、30毫米機砲彈、122與152毫米砲彈、9M117 Grom與9M120 Ataka-S導彈，以及S-125使用的3M9防空導彈。公開資料沒有可靠的每營彈藥基數、每日射擊量和油料補充量，因此不能負責任地寫出未經證實的砲彈數量或精確補給時間。
kitsEn: Not every type appeared in every sector; the following are models identifiable in the order of battle and logistics inventories of the 58th Combined Arms Army and related aviation forces, and all of them entered service before 2008. Russian ground forces used T-72B and T-72B3 main battle tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BMD-1 and BMD-2 vehicles in airborne and air-assault units, and BTR-80 armored personnel carriers. Their artillery included the 2S19 Msta-S 152 mm self-propelled howitzer, the 2S3 Akatsiya 122 mm self-propelled howitzer, the BM-21 Grad rocket artillery and the 9K33 Oplot tactical rocket system. Aircraft and helicopters included Su-24M, Su-25T and MiG-29K aircraft, Mi-24P/V attack helicopters, and Mi-8MT and Mi-26 transport helicopters. Georgia’s equipment inventory included T-72B and T-72B3 tanks, BMP-1/2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-70 armored personnel carriers, D-30 howitzers, 2S3 Akatsiya and BM-21 Grad systems, while Su-25, Su-22M3 and MiG-29G/92 aircraft were used for combat aviation and S-200 and S-125 systems formed the air-defence inventory. Munitions associated with these systems included 125 mm tank rounds, 30 mm automatic-cannon ammunition, 122 and 152 mm artillery rounds, 9M117 Grom and 9M120 Ataka-S missiles, and the 3M9 surface-to-air missile used with S-125. Public records do not provide a reliable ammunition baseline for every unit, daily rate of fire or fuel replenishment figure, so it would be irresponsible to state unverified shell counts or exact resupply times.
tactics: 7日深夜，喬治亞第2、第3、第4摩托化步兵旅等部隊由戈里、查瓦及其他集結區向茨欣瓦利推進，步兵戰鬥車和坦克沿公路展開，砲兵企圖先壓制南奧塞梯亞武裝的陣地，再奪取埃列德維、阿夫涅維等高地與通往市區的道路節點。南奧塞梯亞武裝依託市區和近郊陣地抵抗，喬治亞的包圍沒有在幾小時內完成。俄軍介入後，第58集團軍以第42近衛摩托化步兵旅、第156摩托化步兵旅，以及空降與空突部隊形成地面骨架；空軍先以Su-24M、MiG-29K和Mi-24進行偵察、壓制和近距支援，再以2S19和BM-21打擊道路節點、砲兵陣地及車隊集結區。Mi-8MT等直升機參與部隊空運，裝甲車隊則沿羅基隧道、茨欣瓦利北側道路和德扎瓦里方向分批推進。南奧塞梯亞武裝提供地面接合，俄軍步兵戰鬥車輸送步兵，坦克在射擊準備後向交叉點和城郊高地推進。阿布哈茲線由俄方部隊與阿布哈茲武裝沿黑海沿岸公路及科多里峽谷施壓，迫使喬治亞把兵力分向兩個方向。約在10日至11日，俄軍推進至戈里外圍，卻沒有沿公路繼續向第比利斯；喬治亞部隊則在補給線受壓、通信中斷和火力分散下逐步後撤。12日停火生效後，前線固定在茨欣瓦利、戈里北面和科多里峽谷一帶。
tacticsEn: On the night of 7 August, Georgian units from the 2nd, 3rd and 4th Motor Rifle Brigades and other formations moved from Gori, Java and other assembly areas toward Tskhinvali. Infantry fighting vehicles and tanks deployed along the roads, while artillery attempted to suppress South Ossetian positions before the troops seized heights such as Eredvi and Avnevi and road junctions leading into the city. South Ossetian forces used positions in and around the city to resist, and the Georgian encirclement did not finish within a few hours. After Russian intervention began, the 58th Combined Arms Army formed its ground backbone with the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Brigade entering from Chechnya, the 156th Motor Rifle Brigade operating from the South Ossetia direction, and airborne and air-assault troops. Russian aircraft such as the Su-24M, MiG-29K and Mi-24 conducted reconnaissance, suppression and close support, followed by 2S19 and BM-21 fire against road junctions, artillery positions and vehicle assembly areas. Mi-8MT and other helicopters took part in troop airlift, while armored columns advanced in stages along the Roki Tunnel, the roads north of Tskhinvali and the Dzhvari direction. South Ossetian forces provided the ground link, Russian infantry fighting vehicles carried infantry, and tanks moved toward junctions and heights on the city’s outskirts after preparatory fire. On the Abkhaz axis, Russian units and Abkhaz forces applied pressure along the Black Sea coastal road and through the Kodori Gorge, forcing Georgia to divide its forces between two directions. Around 10 to 11 August, Russian armored columns reached the outskirts of Gori but did not continue along the road toward Tbilisi. Georgian units then withdrew in stages as supply routes came under pressure, communications were disrupted and fire support became dispersed. After the ceasefire took effect on 12 August, the front stabilized around Tskhinvali, north of Gori and in the Kodori Gorge.
data: 可核對的時間線顯示，7日深夜喬治亞先發動攻勢；8日俄羅斯宣布介入並把第58集團軍投入南奧塞梯亞，俄軍航空兵力與地面部隊同時壓制前線；8日至9日茨欣瓦利市及周邊陣地易手；10日至11日裝甲縱隊推進至戈里及其北郊；12日雙方在莫斯科達成停火協議。13日俄軍開始從戈里等地撤出，26日俄羅斯承認南奧塞梯亞和阿布哈茲的獨立國家地位，29日主要作戰部隊完成從喬治亞其他地區的撤離，但南奧塞梯亞的基地駐軍仍然留下。補給上，俄軍以北奧塞梯亞、羅基隧道和南奧塞梯亞公路維持地面車列，並以茨欣瓦利機場及直升機作空運節點；喬治亞則從戈里、查瓦和首都方向輸送油料與彈藥。山地、單一道路和後方距離使車隊速度受到限制。彈藥種類可確認包括125毫米坦克砲彈、30毫米機砲彈、122與152毫米砲彈及9M117、9M120導彈，但各單位的實際存量與射擊量沒有完整公開紀錄。傷亡方面，俄羅斯國防部在停火期間公布的軍事口徑為64人死亡、183人受傷；喬治亞官方在不同發布版本中分別出現13死149傷與17死171傷。這些是各有統計時點和定義的政府快照，不能當成雙方唯一、精確且可相加的總和；南奧塞梯亞武裝沒有同等可靠的統一名冊，故不補寫未核實的精確傷亡。
dataEn: The verifiable timeline runs as follows: on the night of 7 August Georgia launched its offensive; on 8 August Russia announced intervention and committed the 58th Combined Arms Army to South Ossetia, with air and ground forces suppressing the front; between 8 and 9 August Tskhinvali and its surrounding positions changed hands; between 10 and 11 August armored columns reached Gori and its northern outskirts; and on 12 August the two sides reached a ceasefire agreement in Moscow. Russian troops began withdrawing from Gori and other areas on 13 August. On 26 August Russia recognized the independent-state status of South Ossetia and Abkhazia, and on 29 August the main combat forces completed their withdrawal from the rest of Georgia, although the military base and troops in South Ossetia remained. For logistics, Russia maintained ground columns through North Ossetia, the Roki Tunnel and the South Ossetian road, while using Tskhinvali airfield and helicopters as air-transport nodes. Georgia moved fuel and ammunition from Gori, Java and the direction of the capital. Mountain terrain, single roads and distance from the rear limited column speed. Confirmed ammunition types included 125 mm tank rounds, 30 mm automatic-cannon ammunition, 122 and 152 mm artillery rounds, and 9M117 and 9M120 missiles, but no complete public record gives each unit’s actual stock or rate of fire. For military casualties, the Russian Defence Ministry reported 64 dead and 183 wounded during the ceasefire period; Georgian official releases at different times gave 13 dead and 149 wounded and 17 dead and 171 wounded. These are government snapshots with different dates and definitions, not a single exact total that can simply be added; no equally reliable unified roster exists for South Ossetian forces, so no unverified precise casualty figure is supplied.
cause: 這場戰爭的根源可分成三層。第一，1991至1992年南奧塞梯亞衝突留下的停火線、主權爭端和俄羅斯第777維和營，使第777軍事基地與南奧塞梯亞控制區成為長期爭議。喬治亞把基地和分離武裝視為對主權與安全的壓力；俄羅斯則向南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲分離武裝提供武器、訓練和基地支持，並把第777基地與維和任務視為維持地區穩定及自身安全的安排。第二，2004年玫瑰革命後，喬治亞加速靠近西方並尋求北約整合，北高加索的軍力對比因此更受關注；2008年7月科多里峽谷衝突又升高阿布哈茲方向的壓力。第三，8月7日茨欣瓦利及近郊的炮擊究竟由哪一方先開始，各方說法不一致；可以確定的是，喬治亞隨即發動其稱為「清理」的攻勢，英文常寫作Operation Clear或Clean，俄方則把它描述為對維和人員和基地的攻擊，並以第58集團軍的介入阻止攻勢。直接觸發點因此不是一個已被雙方共同證實的單一命令，而是前一週軍事對抗、當日炮擊和兩方安全承諾同時碰撞的結果。
causeEn: The causes can be separated into three layers. First, the 1991 to 1992 South Ossetia conflict left a ceasefire line, a sovereignty dispute and the Russian 777th Peacekeeping Battalion, which became the 777th Military Base. Georgia regarded the base and separatist armed forces as pressure on sovereignty and security; Russia provided weapons, training and base support to separatist forces in South Ossetia and Abkhazia, and treated the 777th base and peacekeeping mission as arrangements for regional stability and its own security. Second, after the 2004 Rose Revolution, Georgia moved closer to Western institutions and sought NATO integration, making the military balance in the North Caucasus more prominent; fighting in the Kodori Gorge in July 2008 increased pressure on the Abkhaz axis. Third, accounts disagree over which side initiated the shelling around Tskhinvali on 7 August. What can be established is that Georgia soon launched the offensive it called Operation Clear, rendered Clean in some English accounts, while Russia described it as an attack on peacekeeping personnel and the base and used the 58th Combined Arms Army to stop the offensive. The immediate trigger was therefore not a single command event jointly verified by both sides, but the collision of the previous week’s military confrontation, that day’s shelling and incompatible security commitments.
impact: 軍事上，喬治亞在8月7日投入的攻勢被俄軍的航空、砲兵和裝甲協同打斷，前線部隊失去連續指揮，必須退往戈里方向與其他縱深陣地重整；這不是部隊被單一擊滅，而是多個戰區同時失去通信、補給和統一火力的結果。俄軍則證明第58集團軍能在山區建立由公路、空運和航空火力接成的戰役軸線，但也受限於羅基公路、地形、距離和阿布哈茲戰線，不能把一度進入戈里外圍視為能無限制推進到第比利斯。政治上，俄軍行動未取得聯合國安理會授權，停火由薩科齊調解，形成的是軍事停火而非完整和平條約；俄羅斯其後承認南奧塞梯亞和阿布哈茲，喬治亞與俄羅斯斷交，並在9月北約布加勒斯特峰會獲邀加入會員國夥伴計畫。喬治亞還宣布退出《歐洲常規軍備條約》（CFE）的意向，顯示歐洲安全架構也被牽動。這些結果改變了雙方的軍事部署與談判位置，卻沒有消除南奧塞梯亞和阿布哈茲的法律與邊界爭議。
impactEn: Militarily, Georgia’s offensive of 7 August was disrupted by Russian air, artillery and armored cooperation, and its front-line units lost continuous command, forcing them to withdraw toward Gori and other depth positions for reorganization. This was not the annihilation of the army in one blow; several sectors simultaneously lost communications, supply and coordinated fire support. Russia demonstrated that the 58th Combined Arms Army could establish a campaign axis in mountainous terrain by linking roads, air transport and aviation, but the Roki road, terrain, distance and the Abkhaz front limited it; entering the outskirts of Gori did not mean it could advance without limit toward Tbilisi. Politically, Russian military action did not receive authorization from the UN Security Council, and the ceasefire mediated by Sarkozy created a military ceasefire rather than a complete peace treaty. Russia subsequently recognized South Ossetia and Abkhazia, Georgia severed diplomatic relations with Russia, and Georgia was invited into NATO’s Membership Action Plan at the Bucharest summit in September. Georgia also announced its intention to leave the Conventional Armed Forces in Europe treaty, showing that the European security architecture was also drawn into the dispute. These outcomes changed the military deployments and negotiating positions of both sides without resolving the legal and boundary disputes over South Ossetia and Abkhazia.
result: 停火時的實際結果是，俄軍與南奧塞梯亞武裝控制茨欣瓦利及南奧塞梯亞大部分地區，喬治亞部隊撤出該區；俄軍曾短暫進入戈里，之後依協議撤回南奧塞梯亞的基地，阿布哈茲方向的俄軍與阿布哈茲武裝沒有向蘇庫米市中心推進，蘇庫米仍由阿布哈茲分離當局控制；喬治亞仍保住首都與中央政府。協議把戰線固定在一條不完整的停火線上，而不是恢復8月7日以前的全部態勢。8月13日開始的撤軍在8月29日完成主要作戰部隊的離開，南奧塞梯亞仍保留俄羅斯軍事基地與駐軍，阿布哈茲則維持分離當局的實控。8月26日的承認改變了外交現實，卻沒有帶來涵蓋兩個地區的和平協議。戰役因此留下三個具體結果：俄方控制南奧塞梯亞並在外交上承認其地位，喬治亞保住國家生存卻失去原來對南奧塞梯亞的控制，阿布哈茲與科多里峽谷的界線仍是未解決的軍事問題。
resultEn: The practical result at the ceasefire was that Russian and South Ossetian forces held Tskhinvali and most of South Ossetia, while Georgian units withdrew from that area. Russian troops briefly entered Gori and later withdrew to their base in South Ossetia under the agreement. On the Abkhaz axis, Russian and Abkhaz forces did not push into central Sukhumi, which remained under Abkhaz separatist control, while Georgia retained the capital and central government. The agreement fixed the front on an incomplete ceasefire line rather than restoring every condition that had existed before 7 August. The withdrawal that began on 13 August removed the main combat forces by 29 August, but the Russian military base and troops remained in South Ossetia, while Abkhazia remained under the de facto separatist administration. Russia’s recognition on 26 August changed the diplomatic reality but did not produce a peace agreement covering both territories. The campaign therefore left three concrete results: Russia controlled South Ossetia and gave its position diplomatic recognition, Georgia preserved the state but lost its former control of South Ossetia, and the boundary in Abkhazia and the Kodori Gorge remained an unresolved military question.
